skill.name: conductor-setup
skill.description: Initialize Conductor project documentation through guided questions and resumable setup state.
skill.summary: Guides teams through creating Conductor product, workflow, tech stack, and style guide artifacts.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 62 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code spans and code fences in SKILL.md. I found no executable command invocation, prompt injection attempt, credential handling, or network behavior in the reviewed skill. The skill reads local project metadata and creates Conductor planning artifacts, which matches its stated setup purpose.

- If `conductor/setup_state.json` exists with incomplete status: Offer to resume from last step
- Run `Glob` to find package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.toml, etc.

content.value_statement: New projects often lack shared product, workflow, and tech stack context. This skill guides Q&A and creates Conductor artifacts for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Detects greenfield versus brownfield project indicators before setup.
Runs an interactive Q&A flow for product, guidelines, tech stack, workflow, and style guides.
Creates core Conductor files such as index, product, tech stack, workflow, and tracks documents.
Maintains setup_state.json for resumable setup progress.
Uses detected package files to prefill brownfield tech stack questions.
Verifies created files and reports completion steps.
limitations: Requires user answers before each Q&A step can continue.
Does not implement Conductor track creation beyond linking the next command.
Writes planning documents but does not change application code.
Generated style guides depend on templates available in the plugin root.

use_cases.title: Start a New Product
use_cases.description: Create baseline product, workflow, and technology documents before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Standardize an Existing Repository
use_cases.description: Detect current project signals and turn them into shared Conductor documentation.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI Coding Context
use_cases.description: Build reusable context that helps coding agents follow project goals and standards.

prompt_templates.title: Start Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-setup to initialize project documentation for this repository. Ask me one question at a time.

prompt_templates.title: Resume Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue a setup that was stopped earlier.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-setup --resume. Load existing setup_state.json, confirm missing files, and continue from the saved section.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Brownfield Stack
prompt_templates.scenario: Create Conductor context for an existing codebase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-setup for a brownfield repository. Detect package files, summarize the stack, and ask for confirmation before writing artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Team Governance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup with explicit engineering policies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-setup to create Conductor artifacts with strict TDD, required code review, conventional commits, and TypeScript and Python style guides.

output_examples.input: Initialize documentation for a new SaaS project.
output: The assistant asks product and target user questions one at a time.
It creates Conductor product, guideline, tech stack, workflow, and track registry documents.
It records setup progress so the workflow can resume later.
The assistant loads the saved setup state and skips completed sections.
It checks whether previously created files still exist.
It continues from the saved question and updates progress after each step.

output_examples.input: Set up Conductor for an existing repository.
output: The assistant checks common project files to infer languages and frameworks.
It asks the user to confirm detected details before writing artifacts.
It generates documentation aligned with the existing repository.

best_practices: Answer each setup question with concrete product or repository details.
Review generated Conductor files before starting feature tracks.
Use resume mode if setup is interrupted or artifacts already exist.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill for unrelated project management tasks.
Do not skip confirmation when brownfield detection finds existing files.
Do not overwrite existing Conductor artifacts without user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates planning and context documents under the conductor directory.

faq.question: Does it modify application code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on project documentation and setup state files.

faq.question: Can it resume an interrupted setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It can load setup_state.json and continue from saved progress.

faq.question: Does it support existing repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It detects common package files and asks you to confirm the inferred tech stack.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed instructions only use local project files and generated documents.
